title: Why Owner Corrections Survive Regeneration
hook: The website is regenerated from scratch. The owner's correction is still there.
thesis: FYD's deeper experiment is not an AI website builder; it is MESSY WEBSITE to OBSERVATIONS to EVIDENCE to OBJECT GRAPH to OWNER INTENT to PROJECTION. Because owner intent is stored as a first-class, authoritative input separate from the render, regeneration recompiles the same object graph with the same intent and the correction survives. The episode demonstrates it live: source changes, owner corrects, regenerate, correction persists. Same object graph to website, to Ask FYD, to search result, to future social and protocol projections.
